reason: NONE. The first thing I saw was $29.99 for 30 sachets, which is a dollar a day, when I pay 20 to 40 cents for Nature Made or Double Wood. The QR code on every batch is a nice touch for someone who reads labels, but not enough to pay three to five times more for a brand with zero reviews.
objection: A dollar a serving for a brand nobody has reviewed yet, and two capsules a day with no size given. I have left bad reviews on huge capsules, and 200 mg of magnesium in two capsules could well be big ones.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $15 to $18 a box, plus the capsule size stated clearly (small, easy to swallow) and a few dozen honest reviews.
